name: Genus Computation from Digital Surface
definition: Computes the genus g of a digital surface ∂Oα, which is a 2-manifold without boundary, derived from the Majority Interpolation (MI) reconstruction Oα.
summary: Genus Computation from Digital Surface calculates topological complexity via local neighbor counts in Khalimsky space, avoiding mesh traversal by leveraging Majority Interpolation's manifold guarantees.
